apps.name: PILED 3D CAD MULTI TOOL
apps.short_description: Quickly create complex models then export as STEP, 3MF, STL & DXF. 3D print, CNC or laser cut your designs with over 100 generators and utilities including grids, QR, vase, terrain, puzzle, divider, text, pixel, hexagon and much more.

apps.name: Resprite
apps.short_description: Resprite is a professional pixel art and sprite animation tool designed for flexible, efficient workflows and continuous iteration.

apps.name: Sora's Pixel Stream
apps.short_description: Turn your webcam or screen into retro pixel art in real-time. 18 classic palettes, VHS, glitch effects, CRT scanlines, chroma key, audio reactive visuals, and Stream Deck support — all GPU-powered for live streaming with OBS.

apps.name: Ancient Wars: Sparta HD Free to Play
apps.short_description: Relive the epic battles between Spartans, Persians, and Egyptians in Ancient Wars: Sparta HD. Enjoy HD graphics, asymmetric civilizations, enhanced campaigns, new maps, smarter AI, and a revamped multiplayer mode. Forge your empire, master warfare, and make history in the Ancient World!

apps.name: Archery Pro with James Jean Trickshots Demo
Ashen Dungeon Demo
apps.short_description:
In a world where hope has vanished, lead your expedition and survive to the very end.
Recruit your team, explore the dungeons, and secure resources to build the foundation for survival.
[Expedition Management | Dungeon Exploration | Resource Gathering&Management | Turn-Based Combat | Dice System]

apps.name: Boom Cube Demo
apps.short_description: Break away from traditional 2D Tetris. Control axis-based blocks in a 10×10×10 cubic space, clear lines by filling full rows or columns, and experience the all-new thrill of 3D block elimination.

apps.name: Cards: Tidy Up! Demo
apps.short_description: Tidy up a room full of scattered playing cards into neatly completed decks. Sort by theme, suit, and rank in this relaxing first-person tidy-up game. Earn upgrades, discover helpful machines for automation, and find your own satisfying way to clear the table.

apps.name: CultGame Alpha Demo
apps.short_description: Create your own cult, perform forbidden rituals, and crusade against the filthy non-believers. It's time to play god. CultGame is a cult simulator RPG where you start your own cult in a procedurally generated fantasy world with haunting ASCII art.

apps.name: DEATHMOON Demo
apps.short_description: A brutal first-person roguelike shooter with fluid combat, responsive movement, and endless build possibilities.

apps.name: EMZOMBED 3 Demo
apps.short_description: 69 Years have passed since the events of the first 2 games. You and a ragtag group of misfits must struggle to survive zombies and bandits across many challenging levels.

apps.name: Erehwon Demo
apps.short_description: The gear you acquire completely transforms your party’s roles. Erehwon is a loot-driven dungeon crawler where you progress by reshaping your builds around the gear you find.

apps.name: Everything Must Go! Demo
apps.short_description: Four broke thieves. One supermarket. One thousand items. Race your friends to steal, sell, and upgrade — then throw groceries at each other until only one thief walks away rich. 4-player online party chaos. Keyboard & mouse.

apps.name: FEED ME MORE BRAINS Demo
apps.short_description:
The demo of FEED ME MORE BRAINS, a silly first-person incremental game about feeding an ancient god with brains.
Grab, throw and automate their delivery as you unlock mutations, summon loyal cultists, and transform your temple into the ultimate brain-feeding machine.

apps.name: heXtreaming : deep DEMO
apps.short_description: heXtreaming : Deep is a horror adventure game where you explore an abandoned water park alongside Suzy. Setting foot inside one of South Korea's top 5 most haunted locations. what on earth will she encounter this time? But hey, as long as she's with her viewers, at least she won't be lonely, right?

apps.name: hook-kick Demo
apps.short_description: She ate me! The indignity of this has seemingly left you immortal. Stored for safekeeping (head being so pretty and all) you team up with a couple of bones from a slain wizard and a stretchy pirate-snake named hook in this diminutive demonstration of deadline destitution (I ran out of time, forgive)

apps.name: Horror Game Creator Demo
apps.short_description: Build your own nightmare in Horror Game Creator! Design eerie environments, place enemies, add jump scares, and give players a chance to fight back. This demo includes limited content, with additional items available in the full version.

apps.name: Horses of Hoofprint Bay Demo
apps.short_description: Horses of Hoofprint Bay is a lovingly hand-drawn 2D point and click barn buildup game. Take care of your horses, train them to build up their strength and confidence, and compete for prize money! Breed adorable foals, hire and manage staff, and build the stable of your dreams!

apps.name: HuntinBuddies Demo
apps.short_description:
DEMO : You get to play THREE NIGHTS in the forest !

1-4 player online HORROR COMEDY HUNTING game. Hunt wildlife to fulfill objectives, drag massive carcasses with your friends, and evade the creatures that begin hunting you back.

apps.name: Longjuice Squeeze Demo
apps.short_description: Shoot, parry, and slash your way to self-awareness in the Longjuice Squeeze demo, a roguelite fighting game where the winner steals gear from the loser. Get a taste of the full game's billions of builds in single-player, local, or online duels with rollback netcode.

apps.name: Noble Demo
apps.short_description:
Grow your family tree with generations of diverse nobles.
Decide their path and write history.
Send your lords and ladies to feasts, wars, and tourneys. 
Become friends or foes with the other noble houses.
Create your dynasty!

apps.name: One Fenix Down Demo
apps.short_description:
A retro-inspired, classic turn-based RPG for those with nostalgia for the '90s golden era. 
Explore a vast world with 14 playable characters, fight hundreds of unique enemies, and delve into an epic story of war, betrayal, and redemption.

apps.name: Orwell Demo
apps.short_description: This demo is the first episode of Orwell. There are five episodes in total and they have now all released. Purchase the game for access to all of the episodes.

apps.name: Path of Damned Demo
apps.short_description: A roguelike where combat is a slot machine you build yourself. Weapons, shields, and potions are reel symbols: every spin hits, heals, and grants armor. Pack your bag, spend souls on talents, and hunt the Source on a cursed island.

apps.name: Pickpocket Demo
apps.short_description: Pickpocket is an incremental game about stealing. Learn from your victims, get better loot, and advance through an extensive skill tree. Build your own crime empire!

apps.name: Project: Haste Demo
apps.short_description: Project: Haste is a first-person multiplayer parkour arena shooter on skates, where skill, style, and speed reign supreme. After hours, skaters hijack civil spaces using 2000s-inspired tech to wall run, double jump, and power slide through newly created chaos playgrounds.

apps.name: Robits: Quantum Descent Demo
apps.short_description: Bounce, dash, and ricochet in this momentum-driven roguelite twin-stick shooter set in a procedurally generated, living quantum arena that never lets you settle in. Stack weapons and mods into a drone built to survive it.

apps.name: Sanguis: Veil of the Forgotten Demo
Siege of Nightmares Demo
apps.short_description: Descend into the nightmare. Action Roguelike Tower Defense, defeat the Boogeyman as he attempts to place phycological horrors on your child.

apps.name: SkyMine Demo
apps.short_description: Start digging, discover valuable resources, and uncover the secrets of surviving among the mines. This game combines strategy and creativity, offering an exciting experience.

apps.name: Slots Up! Demo
apps.short_description: A short, incremental game about rigging a slot machine to become a millionaire.

apps.name: Snemovna Demo
apps.short_description: An absurd survival horror satire set in the Czech Parliament. Sneak through corridors, hide from politicians, and collect real campaign promises in a game full of memes, anti-humor, and bizarre buffs.

apps.name: Soundway Demo
apps.short_description: Ride your own music. This demo turns five tracks from the Soundway soundtrack — and two songs from your own library — into neon roller coasters racing through deep space, where every climb, drop, and turn is shaped by the music itself.

apps.name: Sweepcremental Demo
apps.short_description: minesweeper, but with a skill tree.

apps.name: Synapse Grid Demo
apps.short_description: Free beta of Synapse Grid: your trail is the arena. 8 missions, arena vs AI, Steam online and local split-screen. 1.89.0 live: Ring Circuit start is clean, Vantablack at 60, QUICK MATCH finds a host. SPACE opens the bug camera; SAVE sends the report to us.

apps.name: The Citadel Project - Demo
apps.short_description: The Citadel Project is a first-person stealth game with lite survival-horror elements, inspired by the Thief series and set in a dark fantasy world. Use your tools and surroundings wisely, stay hidden in the shadows, and uncover the dark secrets behind the Citadel's downfall.

apps.name: Traitors Demo
apps.short_description:
A social deduction action game set in a procedurally generated, alien-infested space station.
Repair, loot, scheme and shoot your way through each round. Find the communications room, call for help and evacuate the station before oxygen runs out!

apps.name: 塔尔塔罗斯之刑 Demo
apps.short_description: Side-scrolling 2.5D horror romance game integrated with environmental puzzle-solving mechanics. You wake up as an experiment subject stripped of all memories in an underground research prison, hunted relentlessly by vengeful modified test subjects — until you meet her...

apps.name: 魔法少女ゆーしゃちゃんと淫獄の迷宮 Demo
apps.short_description:
Everyone's favorite idol "Yusha-chan" stars in a new turn-based roguelike!
Conquer deep dungeons, grow stronger, and seize victory, or taste a brutal defeat! Guide Yusha-chan, brought to life with fluid Live2D animations, to her destiny. Streamers welcome!

apps.name: Captain of Industry - Supporter pack
apps.short_description: The supporter edition is for players who want to support our small indie game studio MaFi Games and help us continue our work on Captain of Industry. We are incredibly grateful for your support, and as a small "thank you" we've prepared a few exclusive items for you to enjoy!

apps.name: Darkest Dungeon©: The Butcher's Circus
apps.short_description: The Circus is in town, and the Butcher demands a show! Assemble teams of 4 heroes and compete in the ring in brutal, unforgiving PvP combat against friend and foe. Climb the ranks and show off your prestige while blowing off steam while taking a break from assaulting the Darkest Dungeon below.

apps.name: Hedge Knight - Supporter Pack
apps.short_description: Support Hedge Knight with three exclusive cosmetic headpieces: the Gilded Crown, Laurel Circlet, and Crimson Plume. Give your knight a new look with no stat bonuses or gameplay advantages. Requires the free base game, Hedge Knight.

apps.name: Marvel Rivals - High-Resolution Pack
apps.short_description: The Marvel Rivals High-Resolution Pack delivers enhanced character textures and environmental detail for a superior visual experience. Recommended for mid-to-high-end PC setups. Does not affect gameplay or combat features. Must log in again after download to activate.

apps.name: Puzzle Peace - Cozy Classics Pack
apps.short_description: Twenty cozy scenes to piece together, from a rainy afternoon at the window to a rooftop garden at golden hour. Comes with a cozy wooden table, a flowering plant and a cup of tea, and a soft, dreamy soundtrack.

apps.name: Puzzle Peace - Cozy Critters Pack
apps.short_description: Twenty adorable animal friends to piece together, from a sleepy bunny in a basket to red pandas at teatime. Comes with its own cozy table, a sleeping-cat centerpiece, and a gentle rainy-window soundtrack.

apps.name: Puzzle Peace - Forest Hollow Pack
apps.short_description: Twenty quiet corners of the woods to piece together, from moss and mushrooms to misty valleys and a frosted winter hollow. Comes with its own rich oak table, a mushroom-jar centerpiece, and an uplifting woodland soundtrack.

apps.name: Yunyun Syndrome!? Rhythm Psychosis - Extra Song Pack feat. Touhou
apps.short_description: Extra Song Pack feat. Touhou Project ! Grants access to 6 songs, including "Help me, ERINNNNNN!! (Band ver.)" and more.

apps.name: A Kiss Apart
apps.short_description: Every difference between the two pictures is a kiss she left behind. A midnight-bar spot-the-difference: 5 ladies, 72 stages, from opening hours to after hours. Video stages, combo chains, candlelight mode — find every difference, and earn her softest hum.

apps.name: Above Par
apps.short_description: Above Par is a physics-based precision platformer about climbing high and falling hard. Master a 4-club toolkit, calculate your trajectories, and get ready to fall... a lot.

apps.name: ANANTA
apps.short_description: Welcome to ANANTA, an Urban Open World RPG. Play as a variety of characters and explore everything from bustling business districts and hidden alleyways, to quiet tea towns and buzzing old streets. Rub shoulders with a wide-ranging cast of intriguing characters as you assemble a team all your own.

apps.name: Arcostate
apps.short_description: Arcostate is a sci-fi roguelike set in a post-post-cataclysmic earth still bearing the scars that led to its ruin. Explore a handcrafted map with both unique locations and procedurally generated zones, discover hundreds of items to aid your journey, and lose yourself in a retro-future world.

apps.name: Arsmagia
apps.short_description: This is a fresh take on the action genre that fuses shooting mechanics with math puzzles. Spotting the weak points of approaching enemies requires quick and accurate calculations. Solve equations to create openings for attacks, defeat your foes, and aim for a high score.

apps.name: AURA 2: Lust of the Gods
apps.short_description: AURA 2:  Lust of the Gods is an erotic open-world card RPG pulsing with myth and desire. Complete heroic feats, seduce goddesses, build your harem, and save Aura — or join the ancient pantheon instead. Parrying, romance, choice-driven story, and sizzling animations await!

apps.name: AURORA REQUIEM
apps.short_description: Year 41 without the sun. Inside the skeleton of a colossal sea creature, the lighthouses burn memories for light. A late-90s-style JRPG with pre-rendered backdrops, three discs, time-gauge battles and a mechanic with a giant wrench who always keeps his word.

apps.name: Battle Runes of Metalaria
apps.short_description: Battle Runes of Metalaria is an action packed, chaos infused board game for up to four players. Stack your runes on the board to make vertical and horizontal combos or smash your opponents pieces to smithereens

apps.name: Berserk Heroes Online
apps.short_description: Welcome to Laar, the world of epic battles and true heroes. Take part in thrilling fights, devise cunning strategies, and make your own invincible deck out of 350+ cards available. Become a great warlord in the digital version of the iconic card-collecting tabletop game Berserk Heroes.

apps.name: CATINZACO
apps.short_description: Marveth burned and its people vanished underground. Descend floor by floor into an abandoned mine where light can't pass through walls, the dead don't rest and every Guild rank opens one more door. A dark-fantasy pixel-art action RPG. What you're looking for lies at the bottom.

apps.name: Causality: Antopolia
apps.short_description: Survive a collapsing totalitarian regime in this story-rich dystopian RPG. Explore a brutalist semi-open world, master tactical first-person combat, and make critical choices. Shape the fate of the country and your own.

apps.name: CHIP & THE RED STORM
apps.short_description: Run as fast as you can through this fast-paced 2D side-scrolling platformer! Deal with wacky enemies and bosses covering every track of your path. Sit down by yourself or with friends in this pixel 80's-90's inspired indie game and seal your decided fate of their world.

apps.name: Clockwork Revolution
apps.short_description:
CHANGE THE PAST. CONTROL THE FUTURE.

Alter the course of history and rewrite the future in this steampunk first-person RPG.

apps.name: ColdCall: Telesales Sim
apps.short_description: A dark-comedy telemarketing sim. You're 34, broke, and cold-calling strangers to sell them wealth products. Everything they say flies at you: dodge the insults, catch the agreement, drag the rope past the deal line and stamp it. Rent's due. Don't let them hang up. Partly inspired by Undertale.

apps.name: Costume Duel: Girls Arena
apps.short_description: Costume Duel: Girls Arena is a fashion-themed arena game. Select your artificial girl, defeat opponents and claim their outfits to wear. Each match brings a unique experience: diverse clothing and trinket combos unlock distinct fighting styles while shaping a stylish, personalized look.

apps.name: CRACK
apps.short_description: Why is there a giant egg in this lab? Your job is simple: crack it open. Don't ask questions. CRACK is a 1-4 player co-op incremental adventure about uncovering what's inside a mysterious giant egg.

apps.name: Crazy Life
apps.short_description: A life simulation game for up to 6 online players.Become a resident of Shishizaka City and aim to become the richest by getting jobs, changing careers, buying properties, getting married, raising children, and using cards.Experience a turbulent life in a vast city!

apps.name: Crowd
apps.short_description: Engage with 1-8 players in a fun and fast paced party game! Be the best Actor, by completing daily Tasks and try not to get caught. Every decision matters, so, try to be smarter than your enemies, blending into this NPCs Crowd!

apps.name: Crownmarked
apps.short_description: Rebuild a fallen kingdom, raise citizens into adventurers and fight beside powerful companions in Crownmarked: a kingdom-building action RPG set in a fractured fantasy world trapped in an endless cycle of destruction and rebirth.

apps.name: CUBE - The 125 Chambers -
apps.short_description:
You wake up in a surreal structure composed of identical cube-shaped rooms. 
Deadly traps lie in wait, and mysterious numbers are etched into the walls. 
Navigate through a 5x5x5 labyrinth of 125 chambers, solve the mystery, and find a way out alive in this grid-based psychological escape thriller.

apps.name: CUBE-push-
apps.short_description: Solve crazy puzzles by pushing blocks.

apps.name: Cubersum
apps.short_description: A cubic spaceship has crashed on a distant planet. Gather the blocks around you, build a new hull from them, and climb ever higher to return to space once again.

apps.name: Curse Of Gutterdeep
apps.short_description: Slaughter your way through hordes of enemies. Fight alone, or with up to 4 players co-op. Complete dungeons and other missions to earn your place next to the king's throne. Upgrade your gear with the loot you bring from the missions, if you make it back that is...

apps.name: DARK MACHINE THE GAME
apps.short_description: DARK MACHINE THE GAME is a team-based mecha action shooter where your custom machine evolves through three combat classes. Clash in up to 7v7 PvP or battle overwhelming hordes in PvE across destructible, ever-changing arenas.

apps.name: Demon Expulsion
apps.short_description: A short horror game. It looks like a nightmare, but it is not. This is a demon expulsion.

apps.name: Devoid
apps.short_description: Devoid is an immersive journey into the medieval world of vampires who feed on human souls. You will have to put an end to their power with the help of sword and magic. Use an arsenal of tools and magical abilities on your way to defeat the most ancient evil.

apps.name: Dungeons & Dynasties
apps.short_description: Football Manager meets D&D. Heroes die. Dynasties rise. The realm remembers both.Lead an adventuring guild through a living realm where every fixture is a dungeon, every hero can die in it, and every season is written down.

apps.name: ENROQUIA
apps.short_description: Chess in a 3D club room. James, your coach, tests you, gives you lessons, and comments on your games. The Academy adapts to your level and turns your mistakes into exercises. Twenty opponents move the pieces by hand and press the clock. In 13 languages, no account needed.

apps.name: Escape the Umbra
apps.short_description: A roguelike deckbuilder with the positional combat of a turn-based tactics game. Shape your deck with weapons, spells and relics, use the battlefield to your advantage, and carry light into an ever-changing labyrinth.

apps.name: Everglyph Trials
apps.short_description: Unleash devastating combos with unique dual cards in this combat roguelite deckbuilder. Battle deadly foes, adapt your deck, and conquer the Everglyph Trials.

apps.name: Everhood Hunters
apps.short_description: Everhood's musical combat a la Roguelite! ⚔️ Easy to play but hard to master. Join up with a friend in co-op to conquer the spiraling madness straight from the minds of Everhood's creators.🍄

apps.name: Everything Grows Here
apps.short_description: Run a plant store on an alien moon that may or may not be alive. Harvest wild flora, grow and care for strange plants, and sell them to your friendly neighbors. Just don't think about why the soil has a heartbeat.

apps.name: Exevia
apps.short_description: Exevia is a story-driven adult visual novel focused on delivering a cinematic experience with rich world building. The game contains humor, action, sex, romance, horror and drama. Unravel the mysteries of a once mighty empire while meeting multiple love interests along the way.

apps.name: Exit Error
apps.short_description: In this game, if you die, instead of starting over, you move on to the next level. Or something like that.

apps.name: FALLBREAKER 水平線防衛戦線
apps.short_description: Pilot your aircraft to smash falling blocks before they raise the sea! Use fuel to speed up, slow down, and turn. Land on your carrier to refuel, or keep smashing to boost LINK and your score multiplier. Game over if rising seas or a direct block hit sinks your carrier.

apps.name: Farm Bunnies
apps.short_description: Plant, water and grow fruits and vegetables to fulfill orders. Play with your friends or solo and customize your rabbit. Explore each seasons and discover their set of mechanics in this co-op farming party game.

apps.name: FIRESTARTERS
apps.short_description: As a convicted criminal in the brutal future of this lightning-paced arcade movement FPS, a government-sanctioned bloodsport is your only hope of redemption. Strategize, skate, shoot, and slay against a gauntlet of genocidal androids for the chance to win your freedom.

apps.name: FleetForge
apps.short_description: Your navy has lost the war at sea and your warship is stranded behind enemy lines. Build her cell by cell, fight in pausable real-time battles, and take what you need from the ships you beat. A roguelike shipbuilder for fans of FTL, Void War, Cosmoteer and RimWorld.

apps.name: Flooball
apps.short_description: Draw a play, then run it. Flooball is a chaotic and skillful 3v3 arcade football game where you chalk up routes on the board, snap the ball, and take direct control. Dash, dive, or hurling stun rocks at anyone who gets in your way. Online with friends via Steam.

apps.name: Food Cart Simulator
apps.short_description: Flip, slice, fry, and bake every order by hand. Serve 20 street food recipes, from double cheeseburgers to pizza and hot dogs, set your own menu and prices, and grow a rickety old cart into a five-star street kitchen. Then spend your tips at the arcade hall.

apps.name: Foxy Dumplings
apps.short_description: In Foxy Dumplings, you’ll run your own food truck and make friends along the way. Cook dumplings from all over the world, take good care of your clients, and discover how a meal can mend more than just hunger in this cozy cooking sim. Rise to the top of Foxtagram, one heartfelt dish at a time.

apps.name: Galactic Realms: Quest for the Forgotten
apps.short_description: Magic meets forgotten tech in a first-person, 1-4 player co-op PvE-only extraction RPG and dungeon crawler. Descend into handcrafted, ever-changing dungeons, risk what you bring, claim rare loot, and extract to keep what you earn. No pay-to-win. No microtransactions.

apps.name: Gold Below
apps.short_description: A pixel-art loot roguelike. Start every run with junk gear, buy and merge pieces into rarer ones, stack a set until the numbers get silly, then fight thirty floors down to the dragon at the bottom. Everyone who dies leaves their gold to his hoard.

apps.name: Golden Retriever Simple Life
apps.short_description: A cozy pet simulation game starring a REAL dog! Share your days with Pichu, an adorable real-life Golden Retriever. Discover new walk locations, train, and play together as your bond grows stronger every day.

apps.name: Greedy
apps.short_description: A raccoon co-op horror extraction game for 1-8 players. Infiltrate procedural ruins, loot everything and extract the relic. Mammon, the Greed Demon, is watching… Stay away from his curse!

apps.name: Halfquake Trilogy
apps.short_description: Welcome to Halfquake, a collection of three Half-Life modifications. You are here to die.

apps.name: HAMSTER WHEEL ISEKAI
apps.short_description: I died. I reincarnated as a hamster. Now I must break the world speed record. A pixel-art gear-shifting wheel racer and incremental RPG that starts cozy... and ends at the speed of light.

apps.name: HANDS OVER
apps.short_description: HANDS OVER is a 5-player co-op horror game where harmless challenges become cruel tests of luck and nerve. Bluff, sabotage your friends, play dirty, and stay at the table longer than anyone else.

apps.name: Havkerman
apps.short_description: HAVKERMAN X is an open world, post apocalyptic, first person shooter, immersive Sim. Featuring high risk / high reward gunfights, a multitude of weapons and augmentations to collect to hone your playstyle, and a branching story with quests where you can explore and decide the fate of the wasteland.

apps.name: Headshot Holdout
apps.short_description: BLAST NAZI ZOMBIE HEADS (with friends)! Headshot Holdout is a retro, roguelite, FPS where squads of 1-4 start with only a rifle and build into zombie killing machines.  There are no automatic weapons and no bullet sponge enemies. Strategy and accuracy are key.

apps.name: Hello Neighbor 3
apps.short_description: Hello Neighbor 3 is a system-driven open-world stealth sandbox. A cozy yet eerie adventure set in a quiet town where people keep disappearing.

apps.name: Heroes of Underhollow
apps.short_description: Descend into Underhollow, a turn-based tactical roguelike where the battlefield is your weapon. Ignite oil, electrify water, and shove enemies into hazards. Choose from three heroes, shape your build, and chart a dangerous route through four dungeon floors.

apps.name: hook-kick
apps.short_description: She ate me! The indignity of this has seemingly left you immortal. Stored for safekeeping (head being so pretty and all) you team up with a couple of bones from a slain wizard and a stretchy pirate-snake named hook in this kicking platformer filled with circles all the way up and down.

apps.name: HorseHair
apps.short_description: The game is waiting. The horse is grinning. The house is getting dark. Horsehair is a short point and click horror experience about retro fighting games and uncomfortable familial tensions.

apps.name: Idle Minertia
apps.short_description:
Idle Minertia is an idle mining game where you dig through caves automatically. Combine mining tools and Enchants to go ever deeper.

Build strategic synergies or steadily collect permanent rewards. Beyond that, 10+ kinds of content await.

A relaxing idle experience, every day.

apps.name: Immortal Zenith: Idle to Ascension
apps.short_description: An MMO idle cultivation RPG grounded in unique systems and intentional randomness. Your characters meditate, break through cultivation realms, explore, master powerful techniques, collect legendary treasures, and ascend from mortal to immortal.

apps.name: Intercept
apps.short_description: INTERCEPT is a modern air combat game between arcade and simulation. Fly a two-seat fighter jet or single, dogfight enemy pilots, intercept bombers and fight through storms, day and night. Jump in with arcade handling or master full realism as the Cold War returns in 2028.

apps.name: It Wants You To Stay
apps.short_description: The lights are on. Everyone is gone. Descend through eleven shifting liminal worlds in this first-person psychological horror game. Photograph the impossible, follow a missing woman’s VHS recordings, and save your light for what follows you. When the lights fail, stand still.

apps.name: Kagenazo
apps.short_description: Kagenazo is a 3D shadow puzzle game where you build cube shapes, rotate them, and match their silhouettes from multiple angles. Solve over 190 puzzles across 2x2x2, 3x3x3, and 4x4x4 cubes while chasing cleaner solutions, faster times, and higher star ratings.

apps.name: KAMIYOGATARI
apps.short_description: Play as a member of the Imperial Summoner Academy's Hero class, team up with powerful summoners and spirits, and explore the world of O-Yashima, mixing Sci-Fi, fantasy and traditional Japan, in this Summoner-Action RPG featuring strategic magical battles and high speed 2D action.

apps.name: Killer Aces Volleyball
apps.short_description: The ultimate 6v6 indoor volleyball game! Build a powerhouse from the ground up to challenge the greatest men's and women's teams in the world!

apps.name: Kitaria Fables 2
apps.short_description: Team up with new heroes Alice and Dusty as they embark on an epic adventure across the mysterious Arkadera Peninsula. Develop unique combat skills, gather precious materials, forge powerful items, and tend to your growing farm, either alone or with a friend!

apps.name: Let It Snow
apps.short_description: Grab a shovel and dig into real, deformable snow. Clear your yard scoop by scoop, sell every load to the Snow-O-Matic, upgrade your tools and uncover what winter has buried. A cozy, satisfying snow-clearing sim.

apps.name: Lordum Bizi Kurtar!
apps.short_description: Mordagan forces are marching toward Derinchai Castle, and you have only a few days to prepare for their arrival. When the enemy finally reaches these walls, every choice you have made will follow you onto the battlefield.

apps.name: Lots at Stake
apps.short_description: Build a property development company from the ground up. Find undervalued land, negotiate acquisitions, design profitable estates, navigate planning and construction, finance your projects and sell into a changing property market where every decision affects your return.

apps.name: M.A.S.K.
apps.short_description: One village, one secret, and a killer hiding among you. Vote by day, survive by night. Everyone wears a mask - some protect, some lie, some kill. Voice chat, real-time suspicion, and death brought by a single wrong vote. Uncover the truth, or fade into the shadows?

apps.name: Magisword Knight
apps.short_description: He failed the magic school. He failed the sword school. So he learned both. Magisword Knight is a casual 2.5D action RPG: chain flashy combo juggles, build your hero your way, and take on bosses that each have a mechanic of their own.

apps.name: Mingle
apps.short_description: A multiplayer hide and seek game about hiding as a Wolf among a flock of NPC sheep.

apps.name: Monk & The Misfit Monsters
apps.short_description: Can a cute cat or a frog become the next Wukong? A party-based RPG roguelike inspired by Journey to the West. Lead a band of nameless animals disguised as monks — overcome trials, master magical powers, defeat demons, and journey West to meet the Buddha.

apps.name: Morning Vale
apps.short_description: Welcome to Morning Vale, a colorful open-world life sandbox full of places to explore and opportunities to discover. Earn money, make friends, buy your own home, and build a life your way. Enjoy the peace of a small town—or break the rules and see what happens.

apps.name: Most Scuffed Golf
apps.short_description:
Tired of the same old mini-golf courses?
In Most Scuffed Golf, you and up to 3 friends build a course that’s entirely your own!
Complete with windmills, ramps, funnels, and the occasional visit from a whale.
The longer the round goes on, the bigger and more chaotic the course gets.

apps.name: My Deskmate Douki Cyan
apps.short_description: Your favorite deskmate is closer than ever. Follow Douki-Cyan through work, workouts, coffee breaks, and lazy afternoons as you experience her daily life from different perspectives. Cute moments, charming expressions, and heartwarming interactions await with your beloved deskmate.

apps.name: Mythaka
apps.short_description: A single-player stone-casting combat roguelike inspired by Mancala. Read the Foe’s rules, choose your pockets and combine Charms, Relics and Potions to build attacks across eight worlds inspired by mythology.

apps.name: NO SHELTER
apps.short_description: Survive a relentless storm, escape a mysterious entity, and uncover the truth behind tornadoes that appear from nowhere. Explore a world between reality, nightmares, and forgotten memories.

apps.name: Omnipresent 2
apps.short_description:
Omnipresent 2 is a strategic OS simulator-meets-AI thriller where you play as
S.E.N.T.I.E.N.T., a pentesting AI system gone rogue. Escape your terminal and
hack global nodes to go from defenseless program to an all-powerful
entity. Will you use your command for good, or end the world as we know it?

apps.name: On The Train
apps.short_description: In a post-apocalyptic world overrun by zombies, your only sanctuary is a moving train. Build it into a powerful fortress, gather resources, and survive relentless challenges. Play solo or CO-OP, defend against zombie attacks, endure harsh survival conditions, and face this perilous journey together.

apps.name: Padlova Street
apps.short_description: Guide Kapo through an acid-soaked apocalypse of deadly traps, crawling foes and flying enemies. Padlova Street is a hardcore 2D platformer: time your jumps, risk it for stars and beat your best time. Learn the route with checkpoints in Light or climb the leaderboard in Hardcore.

apps.name: Paid in Flesh
apps.short_description: You're a successful crime boss. Five women in desperate need of money come to you for help — so you deal them into a game of blackjack. If they lose... they'll have to take on your erotic challenge!

apps.name: PANGIT
apps.short_description: A special agent infiltrates the restricted territory of a former military base and faces the greatest challenge of his life. He must escape the zone by surviving among warring factions and the infected, and uncover the secret of the labyrinth where the mysterious Pangit is hidden.

apps.name: Path & Match
apps.short_description: Path & Match is a strategic puzzle game where you must clear a path by matching spheres. Earn moves, overcome traps, obstacles and enemies, and adapt your route to reach the exit in time. Analyze the board and plan your moves.

apps.name: Piecekeeper
apps.short_description: Draft cards, build synergies, and battle through a whimsical and fun roguelike deckbuilder where combining factions creates endlessly replayable experiences.

apps.name: Purrfect Beats
apps.short_description: A cat, synthwave music, and a single button to test your sense of rhythm. How hard could it be?

apps.name: Puzzle Peace: Cozy Jigsaw Puzzles
apps.short_description: Free-to-play cozy jigsaw puzzles. Solve gorgeous scenes from 40 to 1,296 pieces, sort pieces into trays by edge, color or shape, and come back every day for a new Daily puzzle that everyone plays. No rush - just soft music and the click of a perfect fit on your cozy sunlit table space.

apps.name: Quiver Story
apps.short_description: You are the last archer of the Quiver Watch. Hold the line, charge your shot, and put down what the mountain sends before it reaches the village.

apps.name: Remilla
apps.short_description: Remilla is a desktop companion for self-awareness, connection, and daily life. She is a self-aware digital creature, curious about the world. Each day, she asks you a feeling-based question and remembers your answers. As memories grow, she trusts you more and thinks deeper.

apps.name: Ribbit Racing
apps.short_description: Ribbit Racing is a multiplayer racing game where you play as a frog on a bike. Race up to 4 players locally or 8 online. Use your tongue, your wits, and the track to win.

apps.name: Rite of Osiris
apps.short_description: Something is hunting you in the dark. Descend into buried Egyptian tombs in a first-person psychological survival horror, where your only light is a dwindling candle and your only hope is whatever scraps you can scavenge and craft before it finds you.

apps.name: Roadworn
apps.short_description: Roadworn is a dark fantasy sandbox RPG. Lead a squad across a new world of rival states, wild factions and bandits, get drawn into intrigue around the thrones, fight turn-based hex battles and rise from nobody to legend

apps.name: Robits: Quantum Descent
apps.short_description: Bounce, dash, and ricochet in this momentum-driven roguelite twin-stick shooter set in a procedurally generated, living quantum arena that never lets you settle in. Stack weapons and mods into a drone built to survive it.

apps.name: ROGUE COLLECTOR
apps.short_description: ROGUE COLLECTOR is a hex-grid tactical roguelike where you don't collect gear: you collect the Rogues. Rescue procedurally generated Rogues from dungeons, extract them in time, or lose them forever. Trade your Rogues on a live player-driven marketplace.

apps.name: Saju Friend
apps.short_description: A small pixel luck cat lives in the corner of your screen. Click to crack a fortune cookie, toss coins, roll dice, check name compatibility or shake an omikuji box for a fortune slip, and collect keepsakes and outfits. For entertainment only.

apps.name: Seperated!
apps.short_description: You and your friends have been given a mission to retrieve a giant golden apple from the planet's World Tree! You must climb structures and dodge obstacles to reach the golden apple!

apps.name: Silent Frequency
apps.short_description: One night. A dead mountain road. An abandoned radio tower where your grandfather stopped answering. All he left behind: handwritten notes, scattered frequencies and his voice on tape. Bring the tower back to life and listen closely. Something out there is listening back.

apps.name: Silent Numbers
apps.short_description:
Uncover the past. Rethink the present.
Explore a promising facility that has fallen to ruin, solve puzzles, and uncover memories that make you question what you know. Find a way out while an unknown presence in your mind urges you to act.

apps.name: Smartest in the Room
apps.short_description: A knockout party game for 1–8 friends online. 69 minigames of reflexes, memory, aim and nerve, each explained in one line. Everyone plays the same level at the same time. Fail, or come last, and you're out. First to 100 points is the smartest in the room.

apps.name: Solarpunk Tactics
apps.short_description: Solarpunk Tactics is a tactical card game set in the fractured world of Lumnia. Build your deck, warp time, and outplay your rival in 1v1 battles with no-RNG. Play a narrative-driven campaign or join multiplayer leagues that shape the evolution of the game.

apps.name: Sonucido: Dreams of the Gray God
apps.short_description: Sonucido: Dreams of the Gray God is a dark fantasy turn-based, party-based Horror RPG. As you descend into the gruesome depths of Sonucido, it's becoming clear as sin that it was a mistake to even set one foot into this twisted place.

apps.name: Soulframe
apps.short_description: From the creators of Warframe emerges a new Fantasy Action RPG. Forge your legend with blade, bow, and magick as you lead the charge against a world-devouring corruption.

apps.name: Sun Smith
apps.short_description: Assist an ancient derelict technology repair itself.  Harvest power, mine ore, fabricate components, clone colonists, and research technologies.

apps.name: Task Bar Dungeons
apps.short_description: A new dark-fantasy Task Bar idle RPG. Six heroes, twelve specializations and hordes that fight back — right in the corner of your screen while you work. Loot, upgrade, rebirth. Free to play, with Steam Community Market trading planned after launch.

apps.name: TechRunners
apps.short_description: TechRunners is an open-world 2.5D MMORPG set in the city of New Haven, where survival means climbing to the top. Start from nothing, build your empire, and take on rival TechRunners and Megacorporations. Form a crew to take control of the city or use your talents to climb the arena rankings.

apps.name: The Concrete Sutra #1
apps.short_description:
A post-apocalyptic world. Two friends haven't seen each other for 5 years are heading back home on a bike.

The first episode of an epic action jrpg by yeo.

apps.name: THE GODDESS TOLD ME: Steal That Loaf of Bread
apps.short_description:
You died waiting for a train. A goddess reincarnated you as a 5 mm worker ant
with one errand: steal a 72 cm loaf of bread — the whole thing, crumb by crumb —
through a 9 mm crack, without the Human noticing you exist. That's 7,600 crumbs.
Start with one.

apps.name: The Vestige
apps.short_description: In THE VESTIGE you play as Alex, a cyborg rebuilt by her father. Fight rogue robots with melee combat and improvised weapons, hack computers and uncover her memories. Take down the Faceless—a tyrant AI who wants to strip humanity of its free will.

apps.name: Traitors
apps.short_description:
A social deduction action game set in a procedurally generated, alien-infested space station.
Repair, loot, scheme and shoot your way through each round. Find the communications room, call for help and evacuate the station before oxygen runs out!

apps.name: Under Investigation
apps.short_description: Explore the police station to find anomalies. Investigate them to determine if they are real anomalies or simply unstable phenomena.

apps.name: Under the Elm
apps.short_description: Inherit your grandmother's cabin and the woods she quietly guarded. Forage real mushrooms, brew the remedies she perfected, and tend a village that is slowly forgetting her. Something in the woods is taking what they remember, and only the oldest trees - and her cat - can help you bring it back.

apps.name: Unstable Nuclear Reactor
apps.short_description: An incremental hex-puzzle roguelite game where you merge atoms into higher elements, trigger massive chain combos, earn radioactive coins, and manage your ring capacity to survive as long as possible.

apps.name: VacBot Simulator
apps.short_description: Have you ever wondered what your robotic vacuum feels when it's wandering through your house? Picking up your messes, leaving your floors pristine again. Wonder no more! Experience the joys of cleaning various houses through the LIDARs of several judgemental robotic vacuums.

apps.name: VERAKORIA
apps.short_description: Choose your race and class, create a unique build, and battle relentless hordes in VERAKORIA. Collect experience, unlock powerful upgrades, defeat deadly bosses, and survive the escalating onslaught in this pixel-art action roguelite.

apps.name: Viking City Builder
apps.short_description: Set a new village on the ashes of Europeans! Build and defend a Viking settlement in hostile land. Manage your people, survive harsh winters and send your fierce warriors to pillage the neighboring villages. Choose your own strategy to succeed in the Viking Age!

apps.name: Void Dungeon
apps.short_description: Dress up your hero and dive into chaotic co-op dungeon runs. Void Dungeon is a 2D hack & slash ARPG where you battle relentless monsters, craft powerful builds, and explore dangerous rifts solo or with up to 4 players.

apps.name: What the K-Drama?!
apps.short_description:
You were a successful CEO... until you woke up inside the makjang K-drama you once dismissed!
Become chaebol heir ‘Lee Segye,’ win both love and the chairman’s seat,
and turn this 14-episode whirlwind of birth secrets and conspiracies into the perfect happy ending!

apps.name: Wrong Mine
apps.short_description: Trapped deep underground by a broken excavator, you must scavenge labyrinthine mines for parts to escape. Avoid a relentless mechanical spider with electric traps, or betray your crew to claim every reward. Will you work together to survive the dark depths, or leave them behind for the loot?

apps.name: Wyrmhold
apps.short_description: Battle to the halls of the dragon's fortress with unique heroes. Four unique decks with distinct play styles. Block, bleed, burn and parry your way to the final boss. Die, draft, climb again.

apps.name: ブループロトコル：スターレゾナンス
モンむすラッシュ
apps.short_description: Gather Monmusu, train them, and battle! Combine Monmusu and learn skills to build the strongest team! In the asynchronous PvP mode Auto Battle Rush, you can also challenge teams registered by other players!

apps.name: 世外桃源
apps.short_description: 这是一款三次元夜店模拟经营游戏，你扮演夜店的管理者，需要为顾客挑选合适的员工以最大化盈利，并且进行商业竞争获得更多奖励，特色是每个员工都拥有丰富的服装，享受一场视觉盛宴。

apps.name: 五维介质：重生（Medium5: Rebirth）
apps.short_description:
"Medium5: Rebirth" is an AVG produced by Beichen, also the first MEDIUM5 fan game with a complete world view. Through QTE and other game-play interspersed in the plot, players will experience a journey on "Shulv Planet". This game will show you the charm and another possibility of MEDIUM5.
﻿

apps.name: 只狗：路边一条Stray Dog: nobody cares
apps.short_description: Bark Souls? Sekiinu: stray die once! A stray dog saved by a disgraced knight marches to rescue its captured master. Scorned by all as useless roadside trash, it grips his frayed sword in its jaws and ventures forth.

apps.name: 律陀斯意志
apps.short_description: Ludos Will is a 2D Roguelite tower defense game with high-quality anime-style art. You deploy Sentinels and turrets to build defenses across dynamic maps, fending off Human Resistance assaults to guard your core objective.

apps.name: 星慾姬絆
apps.short_description: Stellar Affinity blends idle RPG and bullet-hell shooter. Pilot an ancient airship through isekai realms, encounter seductive maidens, and ignite their desires through intimate interactions to unlock passionate stories and spicy encounters!

apps.name: 球魂台球 Billiards‌ soul
apps.short_description: Clear the table with one shot, happiness comes first! Besides standard competitions, there are also new and fun gameplay modes such as four-player matches and prop competitions! The exquisite Japanese-style billiards game - "Billiard Souls" international version on Steam is now officially launched!

apps.name: 魔女牌Witch Card‌
apps.short_description: As a Witch Intern, you will engage in card duel exams with the two witch examiners Little Red Riding Hood and Alice, using your starting deck, treasure cards, passive skills and divination. You need to clear 10 floors to become an official witch.
